book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Judiya wedi Todedei Si Luweni Hiyede ge Yeisu Si Lopamate
Saugeine Yeisu i gomwao lihulihu ya bwabwaligane, habeto i liwo wana topadavae heidiye i nga,
“Hu lapu ege te yan ho-iwo ege i miyemiye muyai habe Seyok Sagaeine hana sauge, bwen si bwange Tolomo Natune ge si taeman si tagakoros-yan.”
He sauge yake topowo lalahine ge Judiya wedi todedei si mipase topowo lalahine wedi todedei Kaiyapas he wana guwole.
Habeto si nuwotu luluweni mwatan bwele si pagan iloke si bwange sumwan Yeisu ge si lopamate.
Si nga, “Tab ta eginawi he sagae hana sauge hei, hebe habe ta pahugeid boda ge si maleke.”
Vaini Hotiya I Ligin Enunu Yeisu he Kahulune
Yeisu iye mwage Beteni Saimon gane toraupoga he wana guwole,
habe vaini hotiya i luwom heine i loseho poteli hana hao dodohobine, he gamwane enunu bwabwalaiine ge maisane lahine. Sauge Yeisu i tuwodau ge i hanhan, habe enunu yake i ligin Yeisu he hulune.
Topadavae si paidi, hoge si hata mamaliye-yan ge si nga, “I bwe te i ligi pasibaleno-yan enunu yake?
Akum ta paliyan iloke ta howo mwaniine lahine ge ta giyau togulegule heidiye.”
Yeisu hobak i lapu wedi nuwotu, bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Sahe kaiwane ge vaini ya hu tabadiyeye-yan? Ginawi dodohobine suwok te i ginawi heyau ya.
Togulegule hene-bwaimiu ege sauge hohoyowate, agegene nau taine sauge hohoyowate bwaimiu sohode.
Sauge hawesine ege habe a mate. Vaini ya enunu bwabwalaiine i ligin he tuwau, iloke hana hao sohode hobak i bagavetahe mwao tuwau nau ho hotei pado kaiwane.
Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, he panayawi malemaleine, se wabene heine hebe si papalapu-yan wase dodohobine ya, page gane vaini ya i ginawi benan si lihuyan, iye hana baganuwohasik.”
Judas I La Topowo Lalahine heidiye
Bwen topadavae si he-yawate si he-iwo (12) bwaidiye hotiya hidane Judas Iskariyot, i lok i la topowo lalahine heidiye
ge i nga, “Heto sahe bwele hu egiyau heyau hebe Yeisu a waseyan heimiu ge hu bwange?” Habeto mwani silba hana hohoyowate teti (30) si pahone ge si liwo tei te habe si giyau heine.
He sauge yake Judas i telipune i hayaoyan Yeisu wana dodogan, i luweni hiyede iloke i hotei Yeisu he nimadiye ge bwele si bwange.
Yeisu he-bwaine wana Topadavae Si Ginawi Seyok Sagaeine
Pwalawa Bwabwalagimo Sagaeine hana yan dedei, topadavae si luwom Yeisu heine ge si tayak si nga, “Nuwam ha lovivine-yan haga kaiwam igohoi, iloke ta han sohode Seyok Sagaeine hana logugui?”

I golase halingadiye i nga, “Hu lok hu la Jerusalem, tolomo hotiya hei, ge hu liwo heine hu nga, ‘Topapalapu i nga: Lo sauge hobak i sepasepase. He-bwalu lo topadavae tage Seyok Sagaeine hinone ha eginawi he lam guwole.’ ”
Bwen topadavae si ginawi sohode Yeisu wana lihu heidiye ge si lovivine-yan haga Seyok Sagaeine kaiwane.
Sauge i gogou, Yeisu he-bwaine wana topadavae si he-yawate si he-iwo (12) si tuwodau si yabwahanhan.
He hanhan gamwane, habe i liwo heidiye i nga, “Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, he gamwamiu ya bwaimiu hotiya bwele i waseyanau.”
Bwen si hatatilao suwok, hoge hotiya ge hotiya i gotayak Yeisu heine i nga, “Guyau, nau tan sohode, age?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Tolomo hotiya iye bwalu nimamai i dau he nohe hotaege gamwane, bwele i waseyanau.

Nau Tolomo Natune bwele habe a mate sohode Buk Bwabwalene hana lihu. Eu geb! Tolomo gane i waseyanau, benan hana pepelase i kai! Akum veto tolomo yake tab tinane i ehab, iloke lase lahine taine bwele i depaidi.”
Bwen Judas, gane bwele i ewaseyan Yeisu, i nga, “Topapalapu, nau tan sohode, age?” Bwen Yeisu i liwo heine i nga, “Taine, iye te huwo.”
Sauge si hanhan, Yeisu i howo bred, i gomulolu Helak heine habe i pieneene-yan ge i giyau wana topadavae heidiye i nga, “Hu howo ge hu han. Ga yeya iye tuwau.”
Habeto waen hana kom i howo, i gomulolu Helak heine ge i giyau heidiye i nga, “Gen bwabwaligamiu hu mun.
Ga yeya madibau, iye lihu tuwoi tovevai i patolosuwok. Madibau i dau iloke bobode si hoyowate wedi gegi bwele Helak i sawi yok.
A liwo heimiu, waen ga yeya taine hedi a demun, hana had he-bwalu humiu habe waen tovevai ta mun Tamau he wana bagalogugui heine.”
Habeto wok hotiya si wokan ge si setagi si la he Bobokun Oliv.
Pita I Nga Tage Tanhebe I Deyahakan Yeisu

Yeisu i liwo wana topadavae heidiye i nga, “Gogou ga ya bwele bwabwaligamiu hu iwowo yokau, kaiwane Buk Bwabwalene i nga, ‘Sip hedi tomatahasik a leme iloke sip si pelekeyan tomase ge tomase wedi hiyede.’
Agegene lo suwoyuk hedi he muine, gen a dedei a la Galili, habeto muyai habe hu luwom.”
Bwen Pita i golase Yeisu halingane i nga, “Bwagane bwele he-bwalu bwabwaligadiye si iwowo, agegene nau tanhebe a deiwowo yokiwo.”
Yeisu i liwo Pita heine i nga, “Tolosuwok a liwo heim, gogou ga ya pwaol tolomoine habe taine i detan, bwele u yahakanau pape-tuwon.”
Age Pita i liwo heine i nga, “Bwagane hebe bwalu huwo ta mate, tanhebe a deyahakaniwo.” Ge topadavae bwabwaligadiye si liwo sohode hedi Pita wana lihu.
Yeisu I La I Hawanun Getsemeni
Sauge Yeisu he-bwaine wana topadavae si lok si la he malahao hidane Getsemeni, bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hu miye te he ya, nau gen a la he yake ge a hawanun.”
I sehapeid Pita ge Sebedi he-nanatune si he-iwo he-bwaine si lok, ge he sauge yake hatiyene i tilao suwok.
Hoge i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hatiyeu i tilao suwok, tilao ya hawesine ege bwen i lopamateyau. Hu miye te he ya ge he-bwalu humiu gen ta matalale.”

I piliyokid taine hana bwage i degan, bwen i tiyepwahem he kelekele ge i hawanun i nga, “Tamau, hebe bosowaine, bwen tilao hana kom ya tab i eluwom heyau. Agegene tab nau lo nuwotu heine, huwo ege lam nuwotu.”
Habe i sehavile topadavae si he-tuwon heidiye ge i paidiid si hinhiyene. I liwo Pita heine i nga, “Mwatan ge taine bosowaimiu gen awa hotiya he-bwalu humiu ta dematalale?
Hu matalale ge hu hawanun, iloke tab hamnohon kaiwane ge hu esopiyele. Yayaluwamiu nuwane dohob i ginawi, agegene tuwamiu i pwayate.”
Pe-iwoine hedi i la i hawanun i nga, “Tamau, hebe lam nuwotu sohode a mun mwao te tilao hana kom ya ge taine bosowaine u deho yok, gen sohode lam nuwotu.”
Sauge i sehavile, i paidiid hedi si hinhiyene, kaiwane matadiye i won suwok.
Habeto i seyokid, ge i la hedi i hawanun pe-tuwonine, wana hawanun lihuine hotiya ege.
Habe i sehavile hedi topadavae heidiye ge i nga, “Age humiu mwage hu hinhiyene? Hu paidi, hana sauge hobak i sevin ge Tolomo Natune si taeman bobode ngakngakidiye he nimadiye.
Hu suwoyuk ta lowo heidiye. Tolomo gane i etaemanau, sauge ya hobak i sevin!”
Yeisu Si Bwange

Sauge Yeisu mwage i lihulihu, bwen Judas i sevin, iye Yeisu wana topadavae hebwaden si he-yawate si he-iwo (12) bwaidiye hotiya. He-bwaine boda lahine, hebwaden topowo lalahine ge Judiya wedi todedei si patileid. Si loseyomo maleke kilepeine ge hubwahi gane hehunik.
Yeisu hana towase hobak i lihuyan mwao hetutuhi hotiya boda heidiye i nga, “Tolomo gane a nado, iye te hu bwange ge hu yawan.”
Iyete sauge Judas i sevin, i sesuwok i la Yeisu heine ge i nga “Ago, topapalapu!” bwen i nado.
Yeisu i liwo heine i nga, “Heliya, bigi gane kaiwane ge u luwom, gen u ginawi.” Bwen bobode si pilisai Yeisu heine ge si bwange.
Hebwaden gane Yeisu he-bwaine, hotiya wana maleke kilepeine i warol tagan he habane, bwen i gotem yok topowo lalahine wedi todedei wana tokaiwo hotiya batine.
Yeisu i liwo heine i nga, “Lam maleke kilepeine gen u hotei pahavile he habane, kaiwane sega hebe i lomaleke he kilepe, bwele si leme hedi he kilepe hei.
Age taine hu delapu te bosowaiu ege a gon Tamau heine labe kaiwane, ine? Iloke petaege bwele i patileid anelose-yan hedi boda lahine si luwom ge si lomaleke kaiwau.
Age hebe a ginawi sohode, taine bosowaine Buk Bwabwalene hana lihu i detabwa tolosuwok, gane i nga tage gen i youmate sohode te sauge ya.”

He sauge yake Yeisu i liwo boda heidiye i nga, “Age nau tohawatautau ge hemi siviye? Iyete hu loseyomo maleke kilepeine ge hehunik ge hu luwom tage hu ebwangeyau, ine? Yan hoyowate a miyemiye ge a papalapu he Guwole Gagabubine hana bakubaku, agegene taine hu debwangeyau.
Bigi bwabwaligane yake hobak i youmate, iloke Buk Bwabwalene gane profet si luluweli-yan i tabwa tolosuwok.” Ge he sauge yake wana topadavae bwabwaligadiye si leke ge si iwowo yok.
Judiya wedi Tologugui Si Pakot Yeisu
Bobode gane si bwange Yeisu, si sehape lok Kaiyapas he wana guwole, iye topowo lalahine wedi todedei. Logugui hana topapalapu ge Judiya wedi todedei hobak si mipase te he yake.

Pita i sedumuyai-yan Yeisu agegene hana bwage i gan, hana had si sevin topowo lalahine wedi todedei he wana bakubaku. Pita i setuk he bakubaku gamwane, bwen i tuwodau he-bwaine tokaiwo, nuwane i paidi sahe bwele si ginawi Yeisu heine.
Topowo lalahine he-bwaidiye Judiya wedi tologugui bwabwaligadiye, si luweni Yeisu hana pwapwatim yoyokapisine iloke bosowaine si liwo gen i mate.
Agegene bwagane bobode si hoyowate si luwom ge wedi lihu yoyokapisine si lihuyan, taine hana pwapwatim hotiya si depaidi. Mwaomwaoine habe bobode si he-iwo si luwom
ge si nga, “Tolomo ya i liwo, ‘Nau bosowau Helak wana Guwole Gagabubine a mwanalake ge he yan ho-tuwon gamwane a pamidi hedi.’ ”
Habe topowo lalahine wedi todedei i suwomidi ge i liwo Yeisu heine i nga, “Mwatan ge taine u degolase halingadiye? Nuwotu gane si lihuyan kaiwam, hana sapu mwatan?”

Agegene Yeisu i mipahab. Habeto topowo lalahine wedi todedei i liwo heine i nga, “Helak yawedine ganganine he hidane hei gen u lihu tolosuwok, ge lama wase u giyau hebe huwo Mesaiya Helak Natune, o taine.”
Yeisu i golase halingane i nga, “Sohode te lam lihu tei. Agegene a liwo heimiu, nau Tolomo Natune benan habe hu paidiyau a tuwodau Helak Togaisi he wana hinone ge a sehudiim he yaluyalu pwatane.”

Iyete topowo lalahine wedi todedei i huge, hoge totone hana kaliko i mwanasase ge i nga, “Tolomo ya i gosenge totone ge i hotei donge Helak hidane. Sowane ti yo. Taine ta deluweni hedi bobode tage si luwom ge si lihu tolomo ya kaiwane. Hobak hu longe i gopalongani Helak.
Mwatan hu nuwotu pagan?” Si golase halingane si nga, “I bosowaine suwok gen i mate.”
Bwen si luwo punpun-an mangingine ge si lemeleme-yan he nimadiye. Topadine si tagalepelepe-yan
ge si nga, “Age huwo Mesaiya? Gen u liwo heyai sega i lemeiwo.”
Pita I Yahakan Yeisu
Pita i tutuwodau he bakubaku, bwen topowo lalahine wedi todedei wana tokaiwo venakau bwaidiye hotiya i luwom heine ge i nga, “Huwo hedi Yeisu gagama Galili bwaine hotiya.”
Bobode bwabwaligadiye he matadiye bwen i yahak i nga, “Taine a delapu sahe te u lihuyan tei.”
Bwen i la i setagi he bagasetuk hei, habe vaini hotiya hedi i paidi Pita, hoge i liwo bobode hebwaden si miyemiye he yake heidiye i nga, “Tolomo ya iye Yeisu gagama Nasaret bwaine hotiya.”
Bwen Pita i yahak-an pe-iwoine, i silosilo ge i nga, “Tolomo tei taine a delapu.”

Sauge hawesine, bwen bobode hebwaden si midimidi he yake si luwom Pita heine ge si nga, “Tolosuwok huwo Yeisu wana boda bwaidiye hotiya, kaiwane halingam hana gun i payoumateiwo te huwo gagama Galili.”
Bwen Pita i silosilo ge i nga, “Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, tolomo tei taine a delapu. Akum taine a delihu tolosuwok, Helak gen i laseyau.” He sauge yake pwaol tolomoine i tan,
bwen Pita i nuwopik Yeisu wana lihulihu gane i nga: “Pwaol tolomoine habe taine i detan, bwele u yahakanau pape-tuwon.” Habe i la i setagi dedelawi ge i tan nabi.
